decision: We will add OrgScopedClient to the seed lib: an org-bound service-role wrapper (org filter on every query, org stamped on writes, FK parents proven same-org).
options_considered: Per-service hand-written .eq("org_id") (status quo, forgettable); a DB composite FK (heavy migration on hot tables); wrapper chosen.
revert_hint: Revert the commit; routers fall back to get_user_client under RLS only if migration 034 is also reverted.

decision: We will make the last 23 orbity tables service-only (migration 034) and move nine routers from the user JWT to the org-bound client.
options_considered: Keep RLS and add backend-side checks only (leaves rule-bypass via PostgREST); service-only chosen per owner decision 2026-11-10.
revert_hint: Re-grant via a forward migration restoring the member policies; revert the router commit together.

decision: We will let HTTPException pass through the routers' catch-all handlers so a foreign reference answers 422 instead of a masked 502.
options_considered: Exception-chain handler at app level (hacky); per-call pre-validation (forgettable); pass-through chosen.

decision: We will harden OrgScopedClient: refuse upserts without org in on_conflict, refuse embeds, hide the wrapped client, batch FK checks, add reference validators.
options_considered: Leave upsert pass-through (cross-tenant row takeover); refuse unless composite org key or ignore_duplicates chosen. Tightening only.
revert_hint: Revert the commit; the orbity upserts and migration 035 revert together.

decision: We will add migration 035: composite org arbiters, lock seed_default_lead_stages, sweep browser-role grants except status_pagina, and org-validate user ids.
options_considered: Cluster-wide default REVOKE EXECUTE FROM PUBLIC (changes every product) rejected; schema-scoped form plus a structural test chosen.
revert_hint: Forward migration re-granting; revert the service commits together.

decision: We will switch audit_trail_enabled on for orbity so staff writes while acting in an agency org record the acting actor.
options_considered: Leave the seed default off (acting writes unrecorded); enable per product like social-wiring chosen.
revert_hint: Set the flag back to False.

decision: We will redact secret-named path params (token, secret, key, signature) to a token fingerprint in the seed audit trail, fleet-wide.
options_considered: Per-product exclusion of the approve/webhook routes (misses social-wiring and future routes); name-based seed redaction chosen. Tightening only.
